policy: Broaden DEVELOPMENT using ONLY already-contaminated (2025-01-24..2026-08-14) historical periods. Clean 2024 holdout territory is never touched. Selection made on regime-diversity/calendar grounds, not on any new outcome (no Task71 family has been evaluated yet at the time this file was written).
already_contaminated_range_available: 2025-01-24 to 2026-08-14 (per Task70's historical_exposure_audit.json, OUTCOME_CONTAMINATED by ORPB_V1/FPRC_V1/production-strategy research and F6's own development)

new_slices_selected.rationale: Falls inside the ORPB_V1 development+validation window (2025-01-24..2025-05-05, already OUTCOME_CONTAMINATED) -- a distinct calendar quarter/regime from the 2026 summer slice already on disk.
Falls inside the FPRC_V1 validation window (2025-05-06..2025-08-14, already OUTCOME_CONTAMINATED) -- a third distinct calendar quarter.

Falls inside the Task46-53/54/56 windows (already OUTCOME_CONTAMINATED for the 35-symbol universe) -- a fourth distinct calendar quarter, giving four non-adjacent regime slices spanning ~15 months without downloading the full continuous range.

no_overlap_with_2024_holdout: All four slices are entirely within 2025-2026; none touch calendar year 2024 (Task70's consumed blocks or the remaining clean territory).
why_not_the_full_continuous_range: The task prefers a broader pool for regime diversity, not necessarily every single day of the contaminated range. Four well-separated ~6-week slices give meaningful cross-regime stability testing (Part 15) at a fraction of the download/compute cost of the full ~19-month continuous range, while still being drawn exclusively from already-contaminated territory.
corporate_action_note: Alpaca bars are requested with adjustment=raw (unadjusted), matching the existing scripts/download_historical_1m.py convention used throughout this program. No split/dividend adjustment is applied. A material stock split within any of these four windows would appear as a single-bar price discontinuity; none of the 35 universe symbols is known to have had a split announced during 2025-2026 as of this task's own knowledge, but this was NOT independently verified against a corporate-actions data source (none exists in this repo) -- flagged as a residual, unresolved data-integrity caveat, not fabricated away.
